title: The Lenches Fireworks Night — The Lenches Club
body: The club's annual Fireworks Night is back, and bigger than ever. We are open from midday and the professional display, fired from the cricket ground, starts at 7.30pm, so arrive early for a good spot. There's a burger van, pork baps and a pick and mix stall, sparklers and glow bands for the children, and after the fireworks the party moves inside for a disco with a DJ until late. Entry is free and no membership is needed.
